app.name: Lockin
language.label: Language
week.title: Week {number}
language.hint: Lockin follows your system language until you pick one here.
today.hint: Space checks off the selected activity
block.empty: No activities for this class yet.
block.hint: F2 renames, Delete removes the selected activity
weekTodos.title: This week
weekTodos.empty: Things to do this week that aren't tied to a class.
settings.noCourses: No courses yet: they appear after the first TimeEdit sync.
template.intro: A template gives every class of a kind the same activity, like “Exercises” after every WPO. Past classes get it too, so you can catch up from week 1.
template.title: Activity
template.confirmRemove: Remove? Open activities from it go too; done ones stay.
template.repeatHint: Give every class of this kind this activity (a template)
semester.title: Semester {number}
semester.subtitle: {year} · week {current} of {total}
semester.empty: No classes yet: they appear after the first TimeEdit sync.
week.noScheduleHint: Add your TimeEdit link and your classes show up here.
schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.hint: Paste a TimeEdit link for your classes and a Ufora link for your deadlines. TimeEdit: choose Subscribe, pick the longest period and copy the link. Ufora: Calendar → Settings → Enable calendar feeds, then Subscribe. The links hold a personal key, so Lockin never shows them in full. The daemon syncs the feeds every hour; without it, they sync when you open the app.
schedule.placeholder: Paste your TimeEdit or Ufora link
schedule.confirmRemove: Remove this feed? Its classes disappear from Lockin; adding the link again brings them back, with their activities.
schedule.historyHint: The link skips classes older than 14 days. Started mid-semester? Download the earlier weeks in TimeEdit (Download → iCal) and import the file once.
schedule.historyResult: {added} of {total} classes added; the others were already known or not in the past.
rules.title: Filter rules
rules.hint: Classes that match a rule are ignored: hidden in the week, left out of the semester overview and templates. One class can still be kept with “Show anyway”.
rules.placeholder: Text in the title, e.g. zelfstandig werk
urgent.listHint: Sorted by how long it’s been open and how close the deadline is
urgent.empty: Nothing urgent: everything that’s due is done.
urgent.emptyActivities: No open activities from past classes.
urgent.emptyDeadlines: No deadlines to do. Add one with Deadline (D).
deadline.title: Title
deadline.needDate: Pick a date (and a time, or leave 23:59).
coming.title: Coming 2 weeks
coming.empty: No deadlines or schedule changes in the next two weeks.
feeds.title: Feeds
schedule.confirmRemoveUfora: Remove this feed? Its deadlines disappear from Lockin; adding the link again brings them back, checked off or not as they were.
feeds.uforaNote: Ufora deadlines are linked to a course by its code.
feeds.uforaAdd: Add your Ufora calendar link under Settings → Schedule to get its deadlines here.
schedule.confirmRemoveImport.one: Remove this class, with its activities? It stays if your TimeEdit link also has it; importing the file again brings it back.
schedule.confirmRemoveImport.other: Remove these {count} classes, with their activities? Classes your TimeEdit link also has stay; importing the file again brings them back.
daemon.notRunningHint: Study sessions only start while the daemon runs. Install it with tools/install-daemon.sh.
sessionDialog.weekly: Every week until the end of the semester ({date})
sessionDialog.partOfRepeat: This week is part of a weekly repeat; changes apply to this week only.
sessionDialog.needTimes: Pick a date and a start and end time.
sessionDialog.endAfterStart: The session has to end after it starts.
sessionDialog.tooLong: A study session can last at most {hours} hours.
sessionDialog.inPast: A study session has to start in the future.
session.leftOut.one: {count} week left out: it overlaps another session.
session.leftOut.other: {count} weeks left out: they overlap another session.
session.daemonDown: The daemon isn’t running, so planned sessions won’t start. Install it with tools/install-daemon.sh.
session.daemonDownRunning: The daemon isn’t running: breaks and the end of this session wait until it’s back.
session.breakHint: Blocking is paused. It turns back on automatically at {time}.
session.creditAfter: Credit left after this break: {minutes} min
session.noCredit: No break credit yet: you earn {credit} min for every {every} min you study.
session.log.startLate: Started late: the PC was off at {time}
session.stopCost: Ending early costs penalty points and a {minutes}-minute wait. You never lose items you own.
session.confirmStop1: Keep this open for {minutes} minutes to end the session. Cost:
session.confirmStop2: , and today won’t count for your streak.
session.nonePlanned: Nothing planned. Plan a session here or from the week view (N).
session.nothingComing: No sessions planned in the coming two weeks.
session.nothingRecent: No sessions in the last 7 days.
profiles.title: Block profiles
profiles.hint: The apps a study session closes and the websites it blocks while you study (not during breaks). Websites are blocked in every browser within about a minute; www. and m. come along. Make as many profiles as you like, e.g. a strict one for exam weeks and a lighter one.
profiles.empty: No block profiles yet. Make one, e.g. “Strict”, and pick the apps and websites it blocks.
profiles.inUseHint: The running study session blocks with this profile: you can add apps and websites now, and remove them after the session.
profiles.deleteUsed.one: Delete? {count} planned session uses it; it will block nothing.
profiles.deleteUsed.other: Delete? {count} planned sessions use it; they will block nothing.
profiles.search: Search your apps, or type a program name
profiles.programHint: for a program that isn’t in your menu, by the name it runs under
blocked.noProfile: This session has no block profile. Pick one when you plan a session.
blocked.emptyProfile: “{name}” has no apps or websites yet.
profiles.websitesSetup: Websites aren’t blocked yet: website blocking needs a one-time setup. Run tools/install-helper.sh in the Lockin folder.
blocked.websitesProblem: The websites can’t be blocked right now. Run tools/install-helper.sh once.
